newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rates down as liquidity fears subside.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rates down as liquidity fears subside.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates were down 25 basis points at 19.00 percent in early trade on Tuesday.

Dealers said rates had declined due to a lack of the liquidity pressures seen in recent sessions when banks were forced to sell paper at high rates to settle balances outstanding with the central bank before Wednesday's deadline.
"The market looks like being stable today as most investors have squared their positions," one dealer said.
Overnight rates on bank paper declined 135 basis points to 20.40 percent.
